title: loranthus scurrula var. buddleioides
intro: Loranthus scurrula var. buddleioides, commonly known as the "Buddleja vine" or "Cape ivy", is a parasitic plant species belonging to the Loranthaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, coughs, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of Loranthus scurrula var. buddleioides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
